achievements.name: Hoop Trundling
achievements.detail: Clear Hoop Trundling by jumping the hoops in time with the call.

achievements.name: Good Enough
achievements.detail: Finish a rhythm game with a Good rank so the next game in that set opens.

achievements.name: Amazing
achievements.detail: Score an Amazing on a rhythm game and collect the medal that rank awards.

achievements.name: First Remix
achievements.detail: Clear the remix that folds one set's four rhythm games into a single song.

achievements.name: Set Complete
achievements.detail: Clear the four rhythm games in a set and then clear that set's remix.

achievements.name: Perfect
achievements.detail: Take a Perfect attempt and finish that rhythm game without missing a cue.

achievements.name: Remix Medal
achievements.detail: Score an Amazing on a remix and take the medal for that stage.

achievements.name: Group Beat
achievements.detail: Earn an Amazing on a multiplayer rhythm game and receive the ring it pays.

achievements.name: Ten Games
achievements.detail: Clear ten different rhythm games on the solo list.

achievements.name: Full List
achievements.detail: Clear every rhythm game on the solo list.

achievements.name: Closing Remixes
achievements.detail: Clear the final set, the run of remixes built from games you already played.

achievements.name: Night Mode
achievements.detail: After a Perfect on one rhythm game, clear three more Perfects in a row on it so the visuals can be turned off.
